articles.title: Anthropic Releases Claude 4 with Extended Reasoning and 2M Token Context
articles.summary: Anthropic officially launched Claude 4, featuring a massive 2 million token context window and an enhanced extended thinking mode that significantly outperforms previous models on complex reasoning benchmarks. The model demonstrates notable improvements in coding, mathematics, and multi-step planning tasks. Early enterprise customers report a 40% reduction in hallucination rates compared to Claude 3.7.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2.5 Achieves Human-Level Performance on MedBench Pro
articles.summary: Google DeepMind announced that Gemini Ultra 2.5 has surpassed human expert-level performance on MedBench Pro, a rigorous medical reasoning benchmark developed by Johns Hopkins University. The model correctly diagnosed complex multi-symptom cases with 94.2% accuracy compared to specialist physicians averaging 91.7%. Google is now pursuing FDA approval for a clinical decision support tool powered by the model.

articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Operator: Autonomous AI Agents for Enterprise Workflows
articles.summary: OpenAI unveiled GPT-5 Operator, a new agentic platform that allows enterprises to deploy autonomous AI agents capable of executing multi-step business workflows across software ecosystems without human intervention. The system integrates natively with Salesforce, SAP, and Microsoft 365 and includes a new safety layer called GuardRail that monitors agent actions in real time. Early pilots at Fortune 500 companies showed a 60% reduction in manual processing time for back-office operations.

articles.title: EU AI Act Enforcement Body Issues First Major Fine to Meta Over Llama 5 Training Data
articles.summary: The newly established EU AI Enforcement Office levied a €480 million fine against Meta, citing violations of the EU AI Act related to insufficient transparency around training data sourcing for its Llama 5 model. Regulators found that Meta failed to adequately document the use of copyrighted European digital content in the model's pretraining corpus. Meta said it plans to appeal the decision and is cooperating with authorities to clarify its data governance practices.

articles.title: Microsoft Integrates RAG-Powered Copilot into GitHub for Real-Time Codebase Q&A
articles.summary: Microsoft announced a major update to GitHub Copilot that introduces a retrieval-augmented generation layer allowing developers to query their entire codebase, documentation, and issue history in natural language. The feature, called Copilot Codebase Intelligence, dynamically indexes repositories and surfaces contextually relevant code snippets and explanations in seconds. The rollout begins for GitHub Enterprise customers this week before a broader release in June.

articles.title: Mistral AI Open-Sources Mistral 3B Edge, Targeting On-Device AI Applications
articles.summary: Paris-based Mistral AI released Mistral 3B Edge under an Apache 2.0 license, a compact but powerful model optimized for deployment on smartphones, IoT devices, and laptops without cloud connectivity. The model achieves benchmark scores comparable to much larger models from two years ago while running efficiently on Apple Silicon and Qualcomm Snapdragon chips. Mistral says it is targeting healthcare wearables and offline enterprise tools as primary use cases.

articles.title: Stanford HAI Report Warns of Cascading Failures in Multi-Agent AI Systems
articles.summary: A major new report from Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute highlights emerging safety risks in multi-agent AI deployments, where errors or adversarial inputs in one agent can propagate unpredictably through interconnected agent networks. Researchers studied 14 real-world enterprise deployments and found that 8 experienced at least one cascading failure event within a six-month period. The report calls for mandatory sandboxing standards and inter-agent communication auditing before large-scale agentic deployments.

articles.title: Sora 2.0 Now Generates 4K Cinematic Video Up to 10 Minutes from Text Prompts
articles.summary: OpenAI quietly updated Sora to version 2.0, dramatically increasing output quality to native 4K resolution and extending maximum video length from 60 seconds to 10 minutes with consistent scene coherence. The new model also supports multi-scene story arcs with persistent character identities across cuts, addressing one of the most criticized limitations of the original. Hollywood studios including Warner Bros. Discovery have already signed pilot agreements to test the tool for pre-visualization and concept development.
